The Diversity Visa lottery registration period runs for about one month in the fall, and it is free to enter. The exact window is set by the agency each year, so the fall timing is approximate until the official instructions are published.

The program is open to nationals of eligible countries. It is one of the few routes to a green card that does not require an employer or a family sponsor, which is why it sits on our recurring-dates page rather than in news coverage.

This is a reference date, not an announcement of anything new. Source: U.S. Dept. of State — DV Program. Nothing here is legal advice.

An interim final rule published in the Federal Register on August 11, 2026 amends DHS regulations so that USCIS may require mandatory electronic filing of certain benefit requests. It is effective the same day it published.

The rule also sets out the process USCIS will follow in connection with that requirement. It is a final rule, not a proposal, and it is in force as published rather than at a later date.

As written, it reaches filers of the benefit requests that USCIS designates for mandatory e-filing under the process the rule establishes. The rule text and the process it describes are the authoritative sources on scope.
